title: F3X Type builder By zl0ew
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local PIXEL_SIZE = 3
local OFFSET_Y = 15
local currentColor = Color3.fromRGB(180, 0, 255)

local function getF3XRemote()
    local tool
    if LocalPlayer.Character then
        tool = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Building Tools+")
    end
    if not tool and LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack") then
        tool = LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Building Tools+")
    end
    if not tool then
        for _, v in ipairs(LocalPlayer:GetDescendants()) do
            if v.Name == "SyncAPI" then tool = v.Parent break end
        end
    end
    if not tool then
        for _, v in ipairs(game.ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants()) do
            if v.Name == "SyncAPI" then tool = v.Parent break end
        end
    end
    if tool then
        return tool:FindFirstChild("SyncAPI") and tool.SyncAPI:FindFirstChild("ServerEndpoint")
    end
    return nil
end

local remote = getF3XRemote()
if not remote then
    warn("zl0ew is l0rd")
    return
end

local function _(args) pcall(function() remote:InvokeServer(unpack(args)) end) end
local function CreatePart(cf) _({"CreatePart", "Normal", cf, workspace}) end
local function SetName(part, name) _({"SetName", {[1] = part}, name}) end
local function SetTransparency(part, v) _({"SyncMaterial", {{["Part"] = part, ["Transparency"] = v}}}) end
local function SetColor(part, c) _({"SyncColor", {{["Part"] = part, ["Color"] = c, ["UnionColoring"] = false}}}) end
local function Resize(part, size, cf) _({"SyncResize", {{["Part"] = part, ["CFrame"] = cf, ["Size"] = size}}}) end
local function SetAnchor(b, part) _({"SyncAnchor", {{["Part"] = part, ["Anchored"] = b}}}) end
local function SetCollision(part, b) _({"SyncCollision", {{["Part"] = part, ["CanCollide"] = b}}}) end
local function SetMaterial(part, mat) _({"SyncMaterial", {{["Part"] = part, ["Material"] = mat}}}) end
local function RemovePart(part) _({"Remove", {part}}) end

local function findNewPart(pos)
    task.wait(0.03)
    local closest, closestDist = nil, math.huge
    for _, v in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if v:IsA("BasePart") and v.Name == "Part" then
            local d = (v.Position - pos).Magnitude
            if d < closestDist and d < 5 then
                closestDist = d
                closest = v
            end
        end
    end
    return closest
end

local spawnedLetters = {}

local function clearOldText()
    for _, p in ipairs(spawnedLetters) do
        if p and p.Parent then
            RemovePart(p)
            pcall(function() p:Destroy() end)
        end
    end
    spawnedLetters = {}
    
    for _, v in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if v:IsA("BasePart") and v.Name == "zl0ew_Letter" then
            RemovePart(v)
            pcall(function() v:Destroy() end)
        end
    end
    print("zl0ew is l0rd")
end

local function buildText(text)
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end

    local basePos = hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, OFFSET_Y, -10)
    local lookDir = hrp.CFrame.LookVector
    
    local currentX = 0
    local letterSpacing = 6 * PIXEL_SIZE

    for i = 1, #text do
        local charStr = text:sub(i, i):lower()
        local pattern = letters[charStr]
        
        if pattern then
            for row = 1, #pattern do
                for col = 1, #pattern[row] do
                    if pattern[row]:sub(col, col) == "1" then
                        task.spawn(function()
                            local xOffset = currentX + (col - 3) * PIXEL_SIZE
                            local yOffset = (3 - row) * PIXEL_SIZE
                            
                            local spawnPos = basePos + lookDir * xOffset + Vector3.new(0, yOffset, 0)

                            CreatePart(CFrame.new(spawnPos))
                            local p = findNewPart(spawnPos)
                            
                            if p then
                                pcall(function()
                                    SetName(p, "zl0ew_Letter")
                                    SetAnchor(true, p)
                                    SetTransparency(p, 0)
                                    SetColor(p, currentColor)
                                    SetMaterial(p, Enum.Material.Neon)
                                    SetCollision(p, false)
                                    Resize(p, Vector3.new(PIXEL_SIZE, PIXEL_SIZE, 1), p.CFrame)
                                    table.insert(spawnedLetters, p)
                                end)
                            end
                        end)
                        task.wait(0.01)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        currentX = currentX + letterSpacing
    end
    print("Ur Skid 🥀")
end

ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

Instance.new("UICorner", Main).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

Instance.new("UICorner", Box).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

Box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
    local cleanText = Box.Text:gsub("[^%w%s]", "")
    if cleanText ~= Box.Text then
        Box.Text = cleanText
    end
end)

    {Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)},
    {Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)},

    local c = cData[1]

    cBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        currentColor = c

    end)
end

    if txt ~= "" then
        task.spawn(buildText, txt)
